title: Find Wachira a Job: AI Portfolio
problem: A PDF resume cannot show live backend, streaming AI, or security skills.
build: Vue 3 and FastAPI app with SSE token streaming, Groq and Gemini fallback, untrusted-input delimiters against prompt injection, per-IP rate limiting, a TTL cache keyed on resume file modification time, and a pytest regression test for partial-reply caching.
outcome: Recruiters can paste a job description and get a verdict grounded in my real resume data. An Excuse Buster answers rejection excuses from the same facts.

title: AyuTech Motors: E-commerce and Inventory Platform
problem: An auto parts business needed inventory, payments, and customer inquiries in one system.
build: FastAPI backend with a Flet interface and Supabase PostgreSQL. Safaricom Daraja STK push payments with webhook callback verification, a WhatsApp to database pipeline through Meta Cloud API, and role-based authentication.
outcome: Automated M-Pesa payment confirmation and routed WhatsApp customer inquiries into the database.

title: End-to-End Medical RAG Chatbot
problem: A medical chatbot needs to answer from a trusted document base, not from the model's memory.
build: Retrieval-Augmented Generation chatbot using Llama 2 and LangChain, with Pinecone for retrieval.
outcome: A working chatbot that retrieves medical passages before answering.

title: Ponzi Scheme Scam Detector
problem: Job seekers can be lured by fraudulent job posts and Ponzi schemes.
build: A web app where you paste a URL or job description. It uses the Groq LLM API to flag fraud patterns.
outcome: A working tool that flags suspicious job posts and schemes.

title: Production RAG pipelines with FastAPI & pgvector
problem: Recruiters and users need answers grounded in real documents instead of model guesses.
build: Chunking and embedding pipeline that stores vectors in pgvector, retrieves the top passages, attaches server-side citations, and streams the answer from FastAPI with a local JSON fallback.
outcome: Every answer can be traced back to a source chunk, and the app still works offline when Postgres is unavailable.

title: Safaricom M-Pesa Daraja STK Push workflows
problem: Small businesses need to collect payment without manually reconciling M-Pesa messages.
build: OAuth token handling, STK Push initiation, callback signature validation, idempotent payment records, and clear failure-path feedback for cancelled or timed-out prompts.
outcome: Payments confirm themselves in the database and every failed prompt leaves an auditable trail.

title: Red-teaming LLMs against OWASP Top 10
problem: LLM applications often trust user input more than they should.
build: A four-level prompt-injection CTF sandbox plus a regression suite covering prompt injection, insecure output handling, excessive agency, and sensitive-information disclosure.
outcome: Attack attempts are rate-limited, flags stay server-side, and every defense is documented in a threat model.

title: Fixing printers when they smell fear
problem: Court staff lose hours to driver conflicts, paper jams, and printers that refuse to acknowledge the network.
build: Judiciary of Kenya placement: endpoint setup, driver reinstalls, spooler recovery, network printer configuration, and a plain-language troubleshooting checklist for recurring faults.
outcome: Battle-tested patience and a lower repeat-fault rate because users learn the first three checks themselves.

title: Troubleshooting your PC & network at 2 AM
problem: A dead connection at 2 AM is never just one problem; DNS, DHCP, cabling, and the ISP all blame each other.
build: Structured triage: link lights, IP lease, DNS resolution, gateway reachability, traceroute, and a written incident note so the next person does not start from zero.
outcome: Faster isolation of the actual fault and fewer panic reboots of equipment that was fine all along.
